subject: Planned rolling restart: I/O driver canary & validation (Aug 28–30)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail engineering <eng@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Planned rolling restart: I/O driver canary & validation (Aug 28–30)

Hi Priya and team,

We wanted to give you early notice of a planned, regional maintenance operation that will run Aug 28 22:00 UTC through Aug 30 06:00 UTC. Purpose: staged I/O driver update to improve throughput stability for long-running KV-cache sessions.

What to expect
- Targeted regions: us-east-1 and us-west-2 internal pools (your traffic will route to nearest healthy pool).
- Rolling restarts; we expect no full-service disruptions. Short tail latencies (1–3s) are possible for requests during active migration of warm KV caches.
- We will run lab canaries first (Aug 28 22:00–23:30 UTC) and only proceed to the broader roll if all canaries pass.

Action for Acme Retail
- No action required unless you are running long-lived pinned sessions—please reply if you have workloads pinned to specific model versions.
- If you want a pre-window runbook or a scheduled dry-run, let us know.

Attachments: maintenance-runbook.pdf (runbook + rollback steps), canary-test-results.csv (preflight baseline).

Key links: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-9012 (canary + rollout plan)

We’ll send a reminder 48 hours before the window and a post-maintenance note with findings.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Retail engineering <eng@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned rolling restart: I/O driver canary & validation (Aug 28–30)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the heads-up. A couple quick questions:
1) Can you confirm whether pinned sessions (we pin to the latest-stable model for a subset of checkout flows) will be migrated automatically during the rolling restart?
2) If we observe elevated tail latency during the window, what is the expected escalation path and contact?

If it helps, we can carve out a 30-minute pre-window sync the week of Aug 23.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Sr. Platform Engineer, Acme Retail

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail engineering <eng@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned rolling restart: I/O driver canary & validation (Aug 28–30)

Hi Priya — good questions. Short answers:
- Pinned sessions: we’ll perform a controlled handoff. Sessions pinned at the model-version level will be honored; if you pin to 'latest-stable' that resolves to a stable model artifact and should remain intact. If you have long-lived GPU-resident sessions pinned to a specific host instance, let us know and we can arrange a host-preservation window.
- Escalation: during the window the on-call SRE (Neha) is primary; backup is Monica. For immediate impact, call the SRE pager or use the incident Slack channel (#infra-urgent).

I’ll schedule a 30-minute pre-window sync on Aug 25 15:00 UTC — Monica, can you confirm?

Link to runbook and canary checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/maintenance/INF-9012

Marcus

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned rolling restart: I/O driver canary & validation (Aug 28–30)

Confirmed — I’m on the August 25 pre-window sync and will own the canary dashboard during the lab run.
Preflight checklist highlights (internal):
- Verify canary baseline against canary-test-results.csv
- Ensure KV cache warmup script is enabled and will run for at least 15 minutes before traffic shift
- Reserve extra capacity in us-east-1 for 01:00–03:00 UTC contingency

I’ll drop the runbook link in the calendar invite.

Monica

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail engineering <eng@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-maintenance summary: I/O driver canary completed (Aug 28–30)

Hi Priya and team,

Thanks again for the collaboration on the canary/rollout. Quick summary:
- Timeline: Aug 28 22:10 UTC — Aug 30 05:45 UTC.
- Outcome: Canary passed; full staged rollout completed. No customer-visible errors reported; we observed transient tail-latency spikes (1–2s) during individual host drain operations which returned to baseline within 90s.
- Impact to Acme Retail: No action required. Pinned sessions were preserved. We did not see model version drift for your pinned flows.

Artifacts
- Postmortem draft: postmortem-draft.md (attached).
- Canaries & metrics: canary-test-results.csv uploaded to the runbook folder.
- Runbook + rollback: maintenance-runbook.pdf (contains rollback steps we used).

If you’d like a short retro with our SRE lead (Neha) to walk through metrics, we can schedule next week.

Link to the full postmortem: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/maintenance/INF-9012

Best,
Marcus
